title: 1D Array Declaration & Traversal
statement: Declare an integer array 'int numbers[5]', initialize it with five integer values at declaration time, and display all elements in a single line using a loop.
hints: Carefully review the requirements in FAST_CL1002_F26_LAB10_P6.
Use standard C++ PF-lab constructs (nested loops, basic arrays, no banned STL).

title: Duplicate Roll Numbers Detection
statement: Identify duplicate roll numbers among N students using a 1D integer array and nested loops. Requirements: 1. Input N (1 <= N <= 100). 2. Store N roll numbers in a 1D array. 3. Use nested loops to find duplicates. 4. Print each duplicated roll number only once even if it appears more than twice. 5. Display a message if no duplicates exist.
hints: Carefully review the requirements in FAST_CL1002_F26_LAB10_P7.
Use standard C++ PF-lab constructs (nested loops, basic arrays, no banned STL).

title: Quiz Mark Frequency & Mode Finder
statement: Count how many times each distinct quiz mark appears for N students using a 1D array and nested loops. Requirements: 1. Input N (1 <= N <= 100). 2. Store student marks (0 to 100) in a 1D integer array. 3. Use nested loops to compute frequencies of distinct marks. 4. Display each distinct mark and its frequency once. 5. Display the highest frequency and all marks tied for it.
